//: Code-runner sandbox import map. Verified 2026-10-31 against deno 2.9.8. The sandbox runs with --no-remote, so any specifier that resolves to a remote URL fails closed. Remapping every file: prefix onto a remote URL therefore turns every file import — relative, absolute, via new Function, or chained through data:/blob: modules — into a blocked remote specifier, while --deny-read already blocks Deno.readFile and the node:fs builtins. This is the layer that closes the import-based file reads (plain import, and `import(..., { with: { type: 'text' | 'json' } })`) that bypass --deny-read on their own. The exact key for the harness is more specific than the file:/// prefix, so the entry module still loads; everything else under file: is blocked.
